atoms.text: Mount Vesuvius is an active volcano in southern Italy. The eruption of Mount Vesuvius, which destroyed the neighbouring cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum, was one of the deadliest explosions in European history.

instruction.text: Reread the paragraph and answer the question.

atoms.text: In autumn 79 A.D., Mount Vesuvius erupted. The cloud of material and gas which erupted from the volcano was over 20 miles high. Several cities in the Roman Empire were buried under ash in the aftermath. The most well-known of these were Pompeii and Herculaneum. Over 20,000 people lived in both cities, and the remains of over 1,500 have been found so far.
